` L877: * Use `button` for an action and `a` for navigation. A link styled as a button still navigates, and a `button` inside a form still submits unless you set `type="button"`. L878: * An icon-only button has no text, so give it an `aria-label` that says what it does. `btn-icon` only removes the horizontal padding; it does not add a name. L879: * Mark a disabled link with `aria-disabled="true"` and `tabindex="-1"`. The `disabled` class is styling only. L880: * Pair `btn-loading` with `aria-busy="true"` and a disabled state. The class blanks the label with `color: transparent`, so the old text is still what a screen reader reads. L881: * A button that toggles something needs `aria-pressed`; one that opens a panel needs `aria-expanded`. Bootstrap sets `aria-expanded` for you on dropdown and collapse triggers. L882: * Color alone should not carry the meaning. `btn-danger` looks alarming, but the label has to say what happens. L883: ## Class reference L884: L885: Every class this component ships, grouped by what it changes. A name in braces stands for a family — `{color}` is any base color, `{breakpoint}` any responsive step. L886: `btn` | component | Container element, on a button or a link L887: `btn-action` | part | Quiet icon button for a card or a table row L888: `btn-actions` | part | Wrapper that groups action buttons L889: `btn-list` | part | Spaces several buttons in a row; add btn-list-center to center them L890: `btn-group` | part | Joins buttons into one control; btn-group-vertical stacks them L891: `btn-toolbar` | part | Groups several button groups L892: `btn-check` | part | Hidden input that turns a label into a toggle button L893: `btn-outline` | style | Transparent fill with a colored border L894: `btn-ghost` | style | No fill and no border until hovered L895: `btn-link` | style | Renders as a plain link L896: `btn-pill` | modifier | Fully rounded ends L897: `btn-square` | modifier | Sharp corners L898: `btn-icon` | modifier | Square button holding only an icon; it still needs an aria-label L899: `btn-floating` | modifier | Pins the button to the bottom corner of the viewport L900: `btn-loading` | behavior | Hides the label and draws a spinner; pair it with disabled and aria-busy L901: `btn-animate-icon` | behavior | Animates the icon on hover, with -pulse, -rotate, -shake, -tada or -move-start L902: `btn-{color}` | color | Any base or social color, for example btn-primary or btn-facebook L903: `btn-sm` | size | Small size L904: `btn-lg` | size | Large size L905: `btn-xl` | size | Extra large size L906: ## CSS L907: ### Variables L908: The component uses local CSS variables on `.btn` for real-time customization.
